import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def compute_gcd_precond (a : UInt64) (b : UInt64) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  True
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def compute_gcd (a : UInt64) (b : UInt64) (h_precond : compute_gcd_precond a b) : UInt64 :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  UInt64.ofNat (Nat.gcd a.toNat b.toNat)
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def compute_gcd_postcond (a : UInt64) (b : UInt64) (result : UInt64) (h_precond : compute_gcd_precond a b) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  result.toNat = Nat.gcd (UInt64.toNat a) (UInt64.toNat b)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
lemma uint64_toNat_lt_bound (a : UInt64) : a.toNat < 2 ^ 64 := by
  first
    | exact a.toBitVec.isLt
    | exact UInt64.toNat_lt a
    | exact UInt64.toNat_lt_size a
    | omega

lemma uint64_toNat_ofNat_of_lt (n : Nat) (h : n < 2 ^ 64) : (UInt64.ofNat n).toNat = n := by
  first
    | exact UInt64.toNat_ofNat_of_lt h
    | (rw [UInt64.toNat_ofNat]; exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h)
    | (rw [UInt64.toNat_ofNat]; omega)
    | (simp only [UInt64.toNat, UInt64.ofNat, BitVec.toNat_ofNat];
       exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h)
    | (simp only [UInt64.toNat, UInt64.ofNat, BitVec.toNat_ofNat]; omega)

lemma gcd_toNat_lt_bound (a b : UInt64) :
    Nat.gcd a.toNat b.toNat < 2 ^ 64 := by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos b.toNat with hb | hb
  · rw [hb, Nat.gcd_zero_right]
    exact uint64_toNat_lt_bound a
  · exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_of_dvd hb (Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _))
      (uint64_toNat_lt_bound b)
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem compute_gcd_postcond_satisfied (a : UInt64) (b : UInt64) (h_precond : compute_gcd_precond a b) :
    compute_gcd_postcond a b (compute_gcd a b h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  show (UInt64.ofNat (Nat.gcd a.toNat b.toNat)).toNat = Nat.gcd a.toNat b.toNat
  exact uint64_toNat_ofNat_of_lt _ (gcd_toNat_lt_bound a b)
  -- !benchmark @end proof

* If `b.toNat = 0`, then `Nat.gcd a.toNat 0 = a.toNat < 2^64`.
